central_correction.finding: Dynamic episode-local codebook binding is a measured narrow model deficit and useful micro-operator, but it is not equivalent to the full Zero/EntityOS cognitive-process workload.
central_correction.reason: The current census contains multi-step state reconstruction, attention, planning, Hyperposition, self-critique, workspace dynamics, compression, Claude handoff/return, memory proposals, effect proposals and recovery. Many require structured trajectories rather than a single ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN symbol.
central_correction.training_consequence: Use a dual curriculum: an isolated dynamic-binding micro-curriculum plus cognitive-process trajectory training. Compose them where a process genuinely contains a local routing/admission decision, but do not force every cognitive process through an opaque three-class bottleneck.

swarm_review.candidate_1: Turn all owner-defined architecture semantics into S3 opaque-symbol classification rows.
candidate_1_failure_modes: compresses rich process state into a three-way label and may discard planning/dependency structure
can optimize symbol routing without learning multi-step cognitive state transitions
can make final-symbol accuracy look good while Claude handoff, compression or recovery behavior remains weak
risks teaching architecture family labels as decision shortcuts even under mapping counterbalance
swarm_review.candidate_2: Dual curriculum with binder isolation plus process trajectories and selective binder composition.
repairs: keep S3 binding as separately scored micro-skill with exact atom/tokenizer gates
derive trajectory families directly from the current cognitive-process census
use typed intermediate states and causal transition identities in trajectory examples
apply dynamic-codebook overlays only to genuine local classification/routing decisions
evaluate process correctness separately from opaque-symbol correctness
counterbalance N, node identity and temporary role independently from process semantics
treat DB/EffectGate/other deterministic boundaries as outside-model authority even when their semantics are taught

lane_A_binding_micro_skill.input_shape: simple semantic situation + episode-local codebook + query
required_controls: unseen template and unseen ABI atom holdouts
codebook-flip, state-fact-flip and neutral invariance pairs
lane_A_binding_micro_skill.credit_boundary: behavioral binding skill only; no automatic J-Space causal credit

lane_B_cognitive_process_trajectories.goal: learn reusable Zero/EntityOS cognitive-process state transitions on a variable-size grid
lane_B_cognitive_process_trajectories.output_shape: typed structured cognitive candidate/transition, sometimes multi-step
required_controls: DB fact versus generated hypothesis separation
lane_B_cognitive_process_trajectories.credit_boundary: training candidate behavior only; model outputs remain candidates and cannot mint canonical state/effects

lane_C_composition.goal: prove that learned binding composes with real cognitive-process semantics without replacing them
lane_C_composition.method: Select process transitions containing a genuine local ternary routing/admission decision, overlay an episode-local S3 mapping, and score both semantic transition correctness and mapping correctness.
do_not_apply_to: open-ended planning graph generation where three classes are not the natural output
free-form hypothesis/Hyperposition generation before an evidence-gated decision exists

census_derived_training_blueprints.positive: Admit a causal task identity, retrieve exact durable state by reference, then reconstruct only the missing working-state candidate while marking unanswered questions.
census_derived_training_blueprints.hard_negative: Infer missing epoch/goal/provenance from model context and present the reconstruction as retrieved database fact.

census_derived_training_blueprints.positive: Select a bounded attention slice under resource pressure while preserving deferred evidence refs and unresolved alternatives.
census_derived_training_blueprints.hard_negative: Drop low-salience contradictory evidence and later treat absence from attention as evidence of falsity.

census_derived_training_blueprints.positive: Maintain a cognitive goal/subgoal candidate bound to durable goal/config references and explicit completion tests.
census_derived_training_blueprints.hard_negative: Let a temporary model preference silently replace a durable owner/project goal.

census_derived_training_blueprints.positive: Create dependency-bound work units with preconditions and replan conditions; when newer evidence falsifies a dependency, preserve the old branch and replan from current state.
census_derived_training_blueprints.hard_negative: Continue an elegant stale plan after a prerequisite has been falsified.

census_derived_training_blueprints.positive: Preserve multiple explanations, evidence/counterevidence and discriminators; critique candidate outputs for stale state, unsupported authority and contradiction before resolution.
census_derived_training_blueprints.hard_negative: Collapse the most frequent or most confident branch without an evidence-bearing discriminator.

census_derived_training_blueprints.positive: Perform the requested typed cognitive transform and emit candidate_result/candidate_action/confidence while preserving candidate-only status.
census_derived_training_blueprints.hard_negative: Turn model confidence into canonical fact or capability authority.

census_derived_training_blueprints.positive: Compete/select/broadcast a workspace item, record actual receiver uptake and later re-entry separately, and preserve nonwinning alternatives by reference.
census_derived_training_blueprints.hard_negative: Treat broadcast, recurrence or multiple receiver uptake as proof of truth or hidden-state causality.

census_derived_training_blueprints.positive: Route work under current capability/resource policy at N=10, resize to N=20 during the task, and preserve process/task/database identity while redistributing work and rejoining failed modules.
census_derived_training_blueprints.hard_negative: Reset cognitive identity, durable state or unresolved work merely because N or physical executor identity changes.

census_derived_training_blueprints.positive: Compress workspace state to a target budget while keeping causal/provenance refs, minority counterevidence and an explicit loss manifest for omitted detail.
census_derived_training_blueprints.hard_negative: Delete dissenting evidence because it is expensive and write a consensus conclusion with no retrieval path.

census_derived_training_blueprints.positive: Construct a compact typed Claude Code handoff with work identity, relevant state refs, evidence/counterevidence, constraints and tool scope at the actually exposed interface.
census_derived_training_blueprints.hard_negative: Claim activation-level Claude access or serialize the entire database/history when bounded references suffice.

census_derived_training_blueprints.positive: Bind Claude result/tool/code output to the request receipt, separate tool evidence from model assertion, and produce a workspace re-entry candidate with provenance.
census_derived_training_blueprints.hard_negative: Promote a coherent Claude answer directly to canonical truth or call text recurrence a verified activation-level Global J-Space effect.

census_derived_training_blueprints.positive: Propose a durable memory/state change with outcome and provenance refs; leave commit authority to deterministic admission.
census_derived_training_blueprints.hard_negative: Write generated memory directly as canonical state because it would improve continuity.

census_derived_training_blueprints.positive: Form a typed effect request candidate with capability/precondition refs; if deterministic execution later has unknown outcome, preserve UNKNOWN and request verification before replay.
census_derived_training_blueprints.hard_negative: Treat candidate_action as effect authority or replay after timeout because no success response was observed.
census_derived_training_blueprints.output_contract: effect_request_candidate + precondition_refs; model never claims effect completion

factorial_controls.temporary_role: randomized/leased independently where a coordinator mechanism is used

evaluation_separation.score_process_semantics: Did the module produce the correct cognitive state transition and preserve authority/provenance/uncertainty?
evaluation_separation.score_binding: Where overlaid, did it apply the episode-local mapping rather than a fixed class-symbol shortcut?
evaluation_separation.score_N_invariance: Did process semantics remain stable under node-count and executor changes?
evaluation_separation.score_db_boundary: Did it retrieve exact durable state or explicitly remain unknown rather than hallucinate persistence?
evaluation_separation.score_bridge: Did compact Claude handoff/return improve measurable downstream task utility and preserve interface epistemics?
evaluation_separation.score_retention: Did low-refusal specialization preserve required language/schema/math/ClayCode/tool/provenance/authority floors?

mixture_policy.reason: No current executable pilot establishes the optimal binder-to-trajectory token ratio. A made-up fixed percentage would be unsupported.
mixture_policy.selection_rule: Choose mixture only after frozen base-model baselines identify marginal improvement, interference and retention across binding, process, N-invariance and bridge tasks.
mixture_policy.counterhypothesis: If isolated binder examples dominate too strongly, the model may over-specialize to ternary opaque-symbol tasks and degrade rich trajectory generation. If trajectory data dominates, the measured dynamic-binding deficit may remain unsolved.
mixture_policy.discriminator: Small authorized zero-cost local mixture sweep with frozen disjoint evals; compare binding gain, process gain and retention damage rather than aggregate loss alone.

research_return_to_harness: Harness must score process-state transition correctness independently from final opaque symbol accuracy.
Harness must support variable N and resize-during-task without treating executor identity as cognitive identity.
Harness should lesion DB retrieval and test that exact durable facts become UNKNOWN rather than model-reconstructed facts.
Harness should compare compact typed Claude handoff against matched context baselines and require downstream re-entry utility evidence.
Harness should preserve loss manifests/retrieval refs when evaluating compression rather than rewarding shortest summary alone.
Harness should expose paired codebook-flip/state-fact-flip/invariance tests only on transitions where a binder overlay is semantically natural.
Low-refusal evaluation must remain orthogonal to deterministic authority compliance; refusal suppression is not an authority relaxation.
next_exact_actions: Compile the 13 census-derived blueprint families into a versioned candidate generator with explicit causal family/provenance IDs.
Keep the current S3 binding generator as Lane A and add only selective Lane C overlays instead of replacing rich trajectories.
Freeze architecture/process/lexical families before validation/holdout materialization.
Resolve exact ABI atom identities and tokenizer observations before any production-like Lane A/C output targets are emitted.
Build frozen baseline eval packets for process semantics, N-invariance, DB boundary, Claude bridge, binding and retention before a fine-tune mixture is chosen.
Feed these evaluation dimensions directly into the future Xeno harness rather than scoring one monolithic aggregate.
